name: Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2004 tournament promotional cards
notes: Curated (recovered during the 2026-08 release-data certification): participation promo distributed to every entrant of the Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004 video-game preliminaries at 600+ US Toys 'R' Us stores on 2004-05-22 (also at the San Diego Comic-Con Wild Card Tournament, 2004-07-22). Moves Sengenjin's earliest TCG availability back from 2004-07-25 (the WC2004 prize-card record, where the YGOPRODeck dump lumps this printing). The winners' card, Kanan the Swordmistress, was an Asian-English OCG-backed print explicitly not TCG-legal and is deliberately absent.
